title: Video modes & clay pipeline
notes:
- Video workspace rework: four generation modes (Reference to video, Start-to-end frame, Video edit, Video extend), duration slider with Smart time, mp4/mov, xN takes
- Clay-to-video pipeline: blockout staging + the official Seedance 2.5 white-model prompt protocol built in
- Seed lock now saves with the project and restores on reopen
- Every generation embeds its seed and model in the file's metadata
- Audio/notification popups no longer hide behind the video-mode panels
